senses.zh_definition: 菲利普；法语男性名字，也可用作姓氏。
senses.en_definition: Philippe, a French masculine given name, also used as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas daripada bahasa Perancis yang digunakan sebagai nama lelaki dan juga sebagai nama keluarga.
senses.nuances: 实际书写使用Philippe。所列IPA是法语读音；具体人物的惯用读音以本人为准。没有上下文时，无法确定它是名字、姓氏或哪位人物。马来语释义为编辑说明，并非资料包提供的DBP释义；status不表示DBP认证。参考：[Wiktionnaire：Philippe](https://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/Philippe)。

etymology.historical_story: Philippe is the French form of Philip, ultimately connected with Greek Philippos, combining elements associated with loving and horses. The name travelled through European naming traditions and developed different spellings in different languages. Its historical meaning explains its origin, but a person called Philippe is not being described as a horse lover in ordinary conversation. [Reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/philippe)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 保留Philippe的原拼写，不擅自改成Philip或Phillip。称呼具体人物前，应确认Philippe是其名字还是姓氏。
